title: Independent Ukraine
summary: Independent Ukraine is a political pamphlet authored by Mykola Mikhnovsky in 1900, advocating for a sovereign Ukrainian state. This work is significant in the context of [[ukraine|Ukraine]]'s national identity and political aspirations.

sections.heading: Background
paragraphs: Independent Ukraine was published in 1900 by Mykola Mikhnovsky, a prominent figure in the [[ukrainian|Ukrainian]] nationalist movement.

sections.heading: Significance
paragraphs: This pamphlet is recognized as one of the earliest expressions advocating for a modern, independent [[ukrainian-state|Ukrainian state]], reflecting the growing national consciousness among [[ukrainians|Ukrainians]] at the turn of the 20th century.

sections.heading: Political Context
paragraphs: The publication emerged in support of the Revolutionary Ukrainian Party, which aimed to promote Ukrainian self-determination and sovereignty during a time of significant political upheaval in [[eastern-europe|Eastern Europe]].
